name: nextjs-vercel

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: only the README says Vercel (a deploy button and a guide); nothing the build reads names a host, no vercel.json or .vercel/, so the audit asks and the agent answers from the Vercel CLI (relaxed from Vercel in fix-scan 2/2)

processes.note: `next build` then `next start`: App Router pages, server actions, route handlers under app/api (Stripe checkout and webhook, user, team) and a Node-runtime middleware.ts that refreshes the session cookie

notBreaks.why: the `pnpm db:setup` script a developer runs once; it writes docker-compose.yml and .env on the developer machine and never runs on the server

notes: Read package.json, README.md, next.config.ts, middleware.ts, drizzle.config.ts, .env.example (names only) and every file under app/ and lib/. Sessions are signed JWTs in an httpOnly cookie (lib/auth/session.ts), not server memory; every logActivity and database call in the server actions and route handlers is awaited before the response, so nothing runs after it; no timers, files, sockets or queues exist on the server side. Migrations are drizzle-kit commands run by hand (`pnpm db:migrate`), not a release step, so there is no release process. The platform is named from the README only, since a template has no host manifest; lib/db/setup.ts and lib/db/seed.ts are developer scripts listed in notOnServer as files rather than folders because lib/db/ also holds the server's drizzle client and queries.
